inj.note: Phillips continues to deal with a hamstring injury he suffered in Week 6 against the Eagles. He didn't practice at all this week, so it doesn't seem that he was particularly close to suiting up. With Phillips set to miss his third consecutive contest, Princely Umanmielen could again be asked to step up as a pass rusher.

news.h: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
news.d: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."
